CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.acteur_est_moi(p_ref text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.est_appel_serveur() OR public.titulaire_est_moi(p_ref);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.detention_active(p_nom text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, country text, city text, jour_debut integer, jour_fin integer, qhs boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT d.id, d.country, d.city, d.jour_debut, d.jour_fin, coalesce(d.qhs, false)
    FROM public.detentions d
   WHERE d.nom = p_nom
     AND d.mode_fin IS NULL
     AND d.jour_fin_effective IS NULL
   ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
   LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.helvetia_debiter_fonds_ordinaires(p_personnage text, p_montant numeric)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN public.helvetia_debiter_fonds_ordinaires(p_personnage,p_montant,'liquide');
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.permis_depot_archive_proteger()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.type_evenement='depot' AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.permis_transactions_internes
  WHERE transaction_id=txid_current() AND acteur=auth.uid()
 ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'depot_permis_commande_versionnee_requise'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END;$function$
